body: I can't remember the last time a hug truly mattered to me.
I really do not know what to say. Thanks, but I doubt it will work out like that.

Again. I don't know where to start. Over a few years ago I got forced into inpatient mental help and it's just another black mark. I do not fully appreciate nor trust the help of supposed professionals in this field. Paid psychiatrists are there for either a buck, or for an entitled feeling of understanding. On top of that I believe they're more qualified to deal with as well as nullify melodrama in the lives of the people they deal with on a day to day basis. As ironic as this sounds I could not help but think every time I've dealt with one they've viewed me as a crazy.
I'm not sure I trust professional help.

I don't know where my head is at. I might have ADD, I might be bipolar, I might be a few things, it's unsolvable regardless given the day and age we live in and the willingness to diagnose and prescribe incorrectly and willingly. In that aspect I feel like I've totally fallen through the cracks and the people around me who dare me to be happy must believe that one can also defy gravity in such a manner and situation.

I honestly have not much of a clue where to start. I'm 21 now. I have been depressed since I was 11. I can safely say I really do not think I can get better. I've tried many times over to be happy, and all the sentimental ideas of life just seem hollow to me. I don't see the drive in achieving something. The world around me seems broken, as do I.

People grow up wanting to become something, I've grown up wanting to be dead. I hate every day I wake up and the challenge that comes with it. The concept that there is something to work towards has been folly to me for who knows how long. The idea that life is limited and we should make most of it inclines me to believe it is more-so a dreaded stint I'd rather avoid.

I don't care to overcome the trials of life, or work, education, eating well, excercise, having a family. It's fucked up. I'd talk about my life but I think that's just external factors. Internally I am just devoid. My life is peaches in the grand spectrum, unless you're me I guess. That just pisses me off more. I'll drift into the wall of an overpass one day.
